title: AYNA test steps
description: An ordered list of keyword steps: a test case, the NL assistant's answer or a playback request. The shared contract of editor, NL assistant, recorder, agent and server. Changing it needs an ADR and all three owners' approval (schemas/AGENTS.md); see memory-bank/decisions/2026-10-27-step-schema-v0.md and 2026-10-28-step-schema-v0-2-rows.md.

version.description: Schema version of this document. Each schema release accepts only its own version; bump it on every change. A 0.1 document becomes a 0.2 document by changing only this field.

steps.description: Steps in execution order. An empty list is a test with no steps yet.

step.title: Step
step.description: One keyword action on one repository object. Before every step, playback waits until the target exists, is visible and enabled (smart wait), for at most timeoutMs. SelectRow then also waits, within the same timeoutMs, until its row exists; a Verify of cell, rowExists or rowCount re-reads the target until the check holds, within the same timeoutMs.

id.description: Step id (UUID) assigned by the server when the step is saved; absent on steps that are not saved yet (NL suggestions, recorder output).

keyword.description: Click: click the target. Type: replace the target's text with value (an empty value clears it). Select: choose the item whose text is value in the target list or combo box. SelectRow: select the row of the target grid or list that row addresses; afterwards only that row is selected. Verify: check the checkpoint on the target. Wait: only wait until the target is ready; never a fixed sleep.

target.description: Logical name of a repository object, never a coordinate or a raw UI Automation property. For SelectRow and row checks: the grid or list, never a row or a cell.

value.description: Text for Type and Select. Not allowed for the other keywords.

row.description: The row SelectRow selects. Not allowed for the other keywords (a Verify gives its row in the checkpoint).

checkpoint.description: The check of a Verify step. Not allowed for the other keywords.

timeoutMs.description: Longest wait for the target (and for SelectRow and row checks, its row or check) to become ready, in milliseconds. Absent means the run's default timeout.

checkpoint.title: Checkpoint
checkpoint.description: Compares one property of the target, or of a row or cell of the target, with an expected value. Text comparisons are exact and case-sensitive.

property.description: Of the target: name: UI Automation Name (a label's or button's text). value: ValuePattern value (the text of an edit box or combo box). enabled: IsEnabled. visible: on screen (not IsOffscreen). checked: TogglePattern state is On. selected: SelectionItemPattern IsSelected. Of a grid or list target: cell: the text of the cell in row and column. rowExists: a row matches row. rowCount: number of rows, header rows not counted.

operator.description: equals / notEquals: whole value; contains: expected is a substring. Boolean properties and rowCount allow only equals.

expected.description: A string for name, value and cell (may be empty), an integer for rowCount, a boolean for the other properties.

row.description: cell and rowExists: the row the check reads. Not allowed for the other properties.

column.description: cell: the column of the cell. Not allowed for the other properties.

row.title: Row
row.description: One row of a grid or list target; a list item is a row with one cell. {index}: the index-th row from the top as the target shows it now, counted from 1, header rows not counted. {value, column?}: the first row from the top with a cell whose text is exactly value (case-sensitive), in that column if column is given, else in any column. A cell's text is its ValuePattern value if it has one, else its UI Automation Name.

column.description: A grid column, by its header text exactly as the grid shows it (case-sensitive): the Name of a column header from UI Automation's TablePattern.

logicalName.description: screen.element in lowerCamelCase ASCII, e.g. login.userNameInput (memory-bank/project/conventions.md).

uuid.description: Lower-case UUID, as the server generates node ids (decision 2026-10-25 graph schema v0).
